chunks: Ishaq said: Muhammad ibn al-Rabi' al-Sha'i informed me, saying:
I debated a man from the Dualists in al-Ahwaz, then I came to Surra Man Ra'a, while something from his doctrine had remained attached to my heart.

As I was sitting at the door of Ahmad ibn al-Khadib, Abu Muhammad عليه السلام approached from the residence of the authorities, heading toward the procession. He looked at me and gestured with his forefinger: 'One, One, Single.'

key_terms.أَحَدٌ: One; an affirmation of divine oneness
key_terms.الثَّنَوِيَّةِ: the Dualists, those who believed in two principles or gods

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Hasan al-'Askari عليه السلام affirm tawhid for someone troubled by Dualist beliefs?
ai.summary: This report recounts how a man was affected by the claims of the Dualists after debating one of them. Imam Abu Muhammad عليه السلام, perceiving his inner doubt, indicated the reality of tawhid with the words 'One, One, Single,' whereupon the man collapsed unconscious.

en.hubeali:
Is’haq said, ‘Muhammad Bin Al Rbi’e Al Shai’e informed me saying, 
‘I looked at a man from the Dualists (believers in two gods) in Al-Ahvaz, then I proceeded to Surmanrayy (Samarrah), and something from his speech was hanging upon my heart.

So I sat at the door of Ahmad Bin Al-Khazeyb when Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) came over from the Public house on the day of the (Sultan’s) procession. So he<sup>asws</sup> looked towards me and gestured by his<sup>asws</sup> forefinger: ‘One! One! Individual! (There is only one God)’.
So I fell down, there being unconsciousness upon me’.
en.sarwar: 20. Ishaq has said that narrated to me Muhammad ibn al-Rabi‘ al-Sa’i has said the following.
“I debated a man who believed in dualism in Ahwaz them went to Surra man Ra‘a. However, his words were stuck to my heart.

I was sitting in front of the door of Ahmad al-Khadib that I saw abu Muhammad (a.s.) coming from the house for public gathering. It was the house wherein on a certain day the Sultan would allow the common people to visit him. The Imam (a.s.) looked at me and made a gesture with his forefinger say One, single and only One.
I fainted and fell on my face.”
